```{r setup, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(multcomp) 
library(stringr)
library(textstem)
library(tidyverse)
library(broom.mixed)  # for tidy()
library(ggeffects)
library(lattice)
library(ordinal)
library(patchwork)

theme_set(theme_bw())
cbPalette <- c("#56B4E9", "#D55E00", "#009E73","#999999", "#E69F00")
vaPalette <- c("#FCC6BB", "#F54927", "#9C2007", "#440E03")
this.dir <- dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path)
setwd(this.dir)
source("../helpers.R")

d <- read.csv("../data/processed_rating.csv")
# 
# non_its <- read.csv("../data/non_italian_participants.csv")
# low_reading <- read.csv("../data/low_reading_proficiency_participants.csv")

names(d)
length(unique(d$Participant))
```


```{r}
d$likert_valence <- ordered(d$likert_valence)
d$likert_arousal <- ordered(d$likert_arousal)
d$val_num <- as.numeric(d$likert_valence)
d$ar_num  <- as.numeric(d$likert_arousal)
d <- d %>%
  mutate(
    Nativeness.n = ifelse(Nativeness == "L1", 0, 1),
    val_c = scale(val_num, scale = FALSE),
    ar_c  = scale(ar_num, scale = FALSE)
  )
```


#Ordinal bad
```{r}

model.ord <- glm(
  Nativeness.n ~ likert_valence * likert_arousal,
  data = d,
  family = binomial
)

summary(model.ord)
```

# numeric good
```{r}

model.num <- glm(
  Nativeness.n ~ val_num * ar_num,
  family = binomial,
  data = d
)

summary(model.num)

anova(model.ord, model.num, test = "Chisq")
```

# centered best
```{r}
# This is with scaled val and ar
model.c <- glm(
  Nativeness.n ~ val_c * ar_c,
  family = binomial,
  data = d
)

summary(model.c)
```


```{r}
str(model.frame(model.c))
sapply(model.frame(model.c), class)
# refit the model with numeric vectors
# ensure numeric consistency
d$val_c <- as.numeric(d$val_c)
d$ar_c  <- as.numeric(d$ar_c)

model.c <- glm(
  Nativeness.n ~ val_c * ar_c,
  family = binomial,
  data = d
)

# prediction grid
newdata <- expand.grid(
  val_c = seq(min(d$val_c, na.rm = TRUE),
              max(d$val_c, na.rm = TRUE),
              length.out = 100),
  ar_c  = seq(min(d$ar_c, na.rm = TRUE),
              max(d$ar_c, na.rm = TRUE),
              length.out = 100)
)

# THIS STEP MUST SUCCEED
newdata$prob_L2 <- predict(model.c, newdata, type = "response")

ggplot(newdata, aes(x = val_c, y = ar_c, fill = prob_L2)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C") +
  scale_color_manual(values = vaPalette) +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted Probability of L2",
    x = "Centered Valence",
    y = "Centered Arousal",
    fill = "P(L2)"
  )
```


```{r}

ggplot() +

  # 1. probability surface
  geom_tile(data = newdata,
            aes(x = val_c, y = ar_c, fill = prob_L2),
            alpha = 0.9) +

  # 2. contour lines (structure of interaction)
  geom_contour(data = newdata,
               aes(x = val_c, y = ar_c, z = prob_L2),
               breaks = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75),
               color = "white",
               linewidth = 0.4) +

  # 3. decision boundary (key interpretive line)
  geom_contour(data = newdata,
               aes(x = val_c, y = ar_c, z = prob_L2),
               breaks = 0.5,
               color = "black",
               linewidth = 0.8) +

  # 4. observed data points
  geom_point(data = d,
             aes(x = val_c, y = ar_c, color = Nativeness),
             alpha = 0.35,
             size = 1.5) +

  # 5. color scales
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("#F54927", "white", "#3C91E6")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = vaPalette) +

  # 6. labels
  labs(
    title = "Interaction of Valence and Arousal Predicting Nativeness",
    x = "Centered Valence",
    y = "Centered Arousal",
    fill = "P(L2)",
    color = "Observed Nativeness"
  ) +

  # 7. clean theme
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```



```{r}
newdata <- expand.grid(
  val_c = seq(min(d$val_c, na.rm = TRUE),
              max(d$val_c, na.rm = TRUE),
              length.out = 250),
  ar_c  = seq(min(d$ar_c, na.rm = TRUE),
              max(d$ar_c, na.rm = TRUE),
              length.out = 250)
)

newdata$prob_L2 <- predict(model.c, newdata, type = "response")
```


# Are they more extreme or varied?

✔ L2 has significantly higher absolute deviation from the mean on valence
✔ L2 distribution is more spread out
✔ Same direction, but weaker effect


```{r}
d$val_extreme <- abs(scale(d$val_num, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE))
d$ar_extreme  <- abs(scale(d$ar_num, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE))

t.test(val_extreme ~ Nativeness, data = d)
t.test(ar_extreme ~ Nativeness, data = d)

var(d$val_num[d$Nativeness == "L1"])
var(d$val_num[d$Nativeness == "L2"])
```

```{r}
p2 <- ggplot(d, aes(x = Nativeness, y = val_extreme, fill = Nativeness)) +

  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.alpha = 0.2) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c("L1" = "#F54927", "L2" = "#3C91E6")) +

  labs(
    title = "B. Valence Extremity by Nativeness",
    x = "",
    y = "Absolute Deviation from Mean Valence"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid = element_blank())

p2
```

```{r}
newdata <- expand.grid(
  val_c = seq(min(d$val_c, na.rm = TRUE),
              max(d$val_c, na.rm = TRUE),
              length.out = 200),
  ar_c  = seq(min(d$ar_c, na.rm = TRUE),
              max(d$ar_c, na.rm = TRUE),
              length.out = 200)
)

newdata$prob_L2 <- predict(model.c, newdata, type = "response")

p1 <- ggplot() +

  geom_raster(
    data = newdata,
    aes(x = val_c, y = ar_c, fill = prob_L2),
    interpolate = TRUE
  ) +

  geom_contour(
    data = newdata,
    aes(x = val_c, y = ar_c, z = prob_L2),
    breaks = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +

  geom_contour(
    data = newdata,
    aes(x = val_c, y = ar_c, z = prob_L2),
    breaks = 0.5,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +

  geom_point(
    data = d,
    aes(x = val_c, y = ar_c, color = Nativeness),
    alpha = 0.25,
    size = 1.2
  ) +

  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#F54927",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#3C91E6",
    midpoint = 0.5
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c("L1" = "#F54927",
                                "L2" = "#3C91E6"))
p1

d_long <- d %>%
  select(Nativeness, val_extreme, ar_extreme) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(val_extreme, ar_extreme),
                      names_to = "measure",
                      values_to = "value")


p2 <- ggplot(d_long, aes(x = Nativeness, y = value, fill = Nativeness)) +

  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.alpha = 0.2) +

  facet_wrap(~measure, labeller = labeller(
    measure = c(
      val_extreme = "Valence Extremity",
      ar_extreme = "Arousal Extremity"
    )
  )) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c("L1" = "#F54927", "L2" = "#3C91E6")) +

  labs(
    title = "B. Affective Extremity by Nativeness",
    x = "",
    y = "Absolute Deviation from Mean"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

p2

#combine

final_fig <- p1 + p2 +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, widths = c(1.2, 1))

final_fig
```
